name: Scavenger Paw
summary: In Deathknell, Scavenger Paw comes from the young, ragged wolves roaming the hills. Newly awakened Forsaken gather the severed paws for local caretakers to stitch into crude protective gear.

sections.title: Cobbled Armor in Deathknell
sections.body: Deathknell's newly returned Forsaken have little to spare. The Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade press against Tirisfal, so every scrap of hide and bone goes to practical use. Novice Elreth assists Shadow Priest Sarvis and gathers paws from scavenger wolves, along with bat wings. She uses them to make serviceable garments and armor for Forsaken who have just risen from their graves, still disoriented by their return.

faq.q: What are Scavenger Paws used for?
faq.answer: Novice Elreth collects Scavenger Paws in Deathknell and stitches raw animal parts into basic armor and garments for fresh Forsaken.
You find them on Young Scavengers and Ragged Scavengers, feral wolves roaming the woods and fields around Deathknell.
Novice Elreth asks for the paws. She assists Shadow Priest Sarvis by treating wounded recruits, tailoring equipment, and outfitting those sent into the field.

angles.text: As a newly awakened Forsaken with decaying flesh and little gear, you can gather parts from local predators to assemble enough armor for Tirisfal's hazards.
As a tailor, you can see how Novice Elreth stitches wolf paws and bat wings into crude gear for the fledgling Forsaken settlements.
